collection.title: Vauxhall Movano 2019 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Movano 2019 - 2021 requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
